# FrameClock

Kind: context · Defined in [`src/logic/components/frame_clock.h`](../../../src/logic/components/frame_clock.h) · Scene / prefab name: `null` · Described in `data/core.json`

The main loop's clock, written before the systems tick

## Fields

| Field | Type | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `dt` | `double` | seconds of this frame (RunArgs::fixed_frame_dt in deterministic runs) |
| `time` | `double` | sum of dt |
| `frame` | `uint64_t` | 1 for the first frame |

## Notes

Emplaced and written by Game.

## Systems that touch it

Read only by: AnimalAgentView, Renderer. Written by: Game. Created by: Game. Destroyed by: —.

| System | Kind | Scope | Access | Where | What it does with it |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| [AnimalAgentView](../systems/AnimalAgentView.md) | system | Host | **read** | tick | frame number written to the log |
| [Game](../systems/service-Game.md) | service | Host | **readwrite+create** | Game::Game, frame loop | dt, time, frame written before the systems tick |
| [Renderer](../systems/service-Renderer.md) | service | Host | **read** | render | time of the frame in deterministic runs (captures, probes). |

## Side effects of those systems

- **[AnimalAgentView](../systems/AnimalAgentView.md)**
  - Loads the animal library index (preinit) and the viewed species (first tick) from disk on the main thread; logs which.
  - With "log", opens the file once (truncated) and appends a CSV line every frame, flushed.
  - ImGui window "Animal".
  - Creates host entities (one skin per world with a built bot, 800 tiles with marks) that are never destroyed (no finish).
- **[Game](../systems/service-Game.md)**
  - Reads and writes ./config.7.json; reads resources/graphics.json and the scene files.
  - Creates the Renderer (Vulkan, SDL window, OpenXR).
  - Creates the host thread pool (tf::Executor).
  - Logs unknown arguments, ignored values, the graphics level and scene errors.
- **[Renderer](../systems/service-Renderer.md)**
  - Creates the window, OpenXR session, Vulkan device and swapchain through Context.
  - Makes Lights, RayScene, ProbeVolume, PlantVolumes (with ray tracing), TreeShade, SoilMaps, ClassicRender, VRRender and the passes (SkyPass first, then the scene's renderer.passes).
  - GPU: per-frame fences and semaphores; one transfer, one compute and one graphics submission a frame; waits on the frame fence in prepare and on device idle in init and finish.
  - Threads: records both targets concurrently on the taskflow executor.
  - Log: 'Renderer : unknown pass <name>' (error).
  - Profiler zones: create lighting and targets, create pass / pipelines <name>, update <pass>, Update, Record, Submit.
